status.x-ask: What status should this plan show?

last_updated.description: Date the user says the plan was last updated.
last_updated.x-ask: What date should we use for last updated?

problem.description: The problem the company addresses, in the user's words.
problem.x-ask: What problem does the company solve?

solution.description: What the company offers as the solution.

customer.description: Who the customer is. Do not invent customer names.

offer.description: What is sold and how it is packaged.
offer.x-ask: What exactly do you sell, and how is it packaged?

go_to_market.description: How the user plans to reach customers.
go_to_market.x-ask: How will you reach the first customers?

team.description: People the user named. Do not add anyone they did not name.
team.x-ask: Who is on the team, and what does each person do? Skip anyone you don't want named.

starting_capital.description: Starting capital the user stated. Leave null when they did not give a number.
starting_capital.x-ask: How much starting capital do you have? Say if you don't want a number in the plan.

financials.description: One numeric series for the financials chart. Omit the chart when this is null.
financials.x-ask: Do you have financial figures to chart? If so, share the period labels, the series name, and one number per period.

series.description: Numeric values the user provided, one per label.

seriesName.description: Name of the series, such as Monthly revenue.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the user explicitly asked to include.
assumptions.x-ask: Which assumptions should be labeled in the plan?

missing_info.description: Required fields the user declined to answer. The agent fills this while validating.
missing_info.x-ask: Which required facts are you leaving unanswered?

text.description: A required fact that is still missing.
